The 94 stock wrappers and BG_OPA wrapper at runtime 0x002be508 call this dispatcher with the same four-register AAPCS. Runtime style setter 0x002becb8 calls populated memmove 0x00276818 at 0x002bed24; executing its load-address copy incorrectly branches from 0xc108b90 to zero-filled 0xc0c0684. Exact IDA and isolated emulator memory confirm these copies; existing proof and approval metadata are retained.
